content: Newsletters and Archived Communications Print Minus Related Pages 2025 2020 2019 2018 2017 2016 September September 2025 LTCF Newsletter [PDF – 2 MB] On behalf of the Post Acute Care Team, we are excited to announce the release of the Long-Term Care Newsletter! This newsletter features the latest updates and helpful tips for using the National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN) application. This tool helps long-term care facilities find issues and track their progress in preventing infections.
